Name: Take All
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[i]This mod is by request to update the existing Tab Autoloot mod.[/i]

With this mod you can take all items in any chest or chest-like menu by pressing a customizable hotkey (default [b]Tab[/b]).

If you hold down the mod key (default [b]Left Shift[/b]) it will only take items that are the same as ones you already have in your inventory. You can reverse this behaviour in the config.

You can have the mod automatically close the menu after taking in the config.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can edit the config.json file that is created when first running the game or use GMCM.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
